scope: Host-only ColorOS pipeline regression checks. No ADB, phone access, full ROM build or server baseline modification.

runs.skip_reason: Pinned parser root and native-tool directory were not configured.

runs.command: MYSTIC_SOURCE_ROOT=<pinned-readers> COLOROS_NATIVE_TOOL_DIR=/usr/bin PYTHONPATH=<repository> python3 -B -m unittest -v test_coloros17_metadata.ExporterTests test_coloros17_build_image.NativeBuilderTests

limits: Host test fixtures are not the complete Global image.
Local native-tool hashes identify this test environment, not the pinned production server toolchain.
These checks do not establish phone hardware compatibility or resolve untested AI, AOD, camera or certification features.
